PR #2657 (BUG-2010) updated and pushed at 1d802396b6aeee06ff221a8a2a80215780c101ec.

Items addressed:
1. Extracted pub(crate) fn queue_work_self_claim(no_launch: bool) -> bool { no_launch } in queue_cmd.rs and used it at :12253.
2. Updated the launch case to call session_start(..., queue_work_self_claim(false), ...) and added asserts:
   assert!(!queue_work_self_claim(false));
   assert!(queue_work_self_claim(true));
   The no-launch case continues to use handle_queue_work.
3. Updated stale assertion messages to 'when self_claim is false'.
4. Mutation-check verified: mutated queue_work_self_claim to return true and confirmed test_queue_work_respects_no_launch_for_calling_lane_attribution FAILED on assertion, then restored.
5. Ran make check-ci-compile (1/1 gate passed) and make check-ci-fast (28/28 fast gates passed).
6. Single test passed cleanly with restored helper.
